messages.content: Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. Copy the span of words that lies between (and including) index 5 and 15, the indices are word indices, split by whitespace!

message.content:
FADE IN: EXT. OCEAN - DAY

A silver fish thrashes violently as a rough hand yanks it from the deep blue abyss into the blinding white light of the afternoon sun. The human holds the struggling creature up, not to kill, but to force its gills to gasp at the air while turning it slowly towards the sky where the moon begins
